title: NodeDef
description: design/developers/plugin_model.md §3 (NodeDef object): the template a Node is an instance of -- properties, commands, and links. Restructured from iox-vscode-plugin's node.schema.json/common.node.schema.json (the `allOf` split between the two, and the `parent` field, are ioxplugin-dialect scaffolding for a protocol-conditional root shape Dynamic Profiles doesn't have -- flattened into one schema here, `parent` dropped as a live-instance/runtime concept, not a NodeDef field). Only `id` is required: `name`/`properties`/`cmds`/`links` all have no '(Optional)' marker in the spec's own table, and §3's worked CTL example includes every one of them (even empty `cmds.sends`/`links.ctl`/`links.rsp` arrays) -- but src/nucore/profile.py's actual parser tolerates all of them being entirely absent (`ndict.get("properties", {})`, `ndict.get("cmds", {})`, `ndict.get("links", None)`), and the existing test fixture (tests/unified/dev_tools/test_profile_authoring.py's VALID_PROFILE) omits `links` and `desc` entirely. This schema follows the lenient-parser behavior, not the table's literal formatting, matching design/developers/nucore_domain_model.md §14's documented design choice ('Parsing is lenient, not strict') -- see schemas/README.md.

customicon.description: Future use. Note: src/nucore/nodedef.py's parser currently populates this field from whichever of the spec's `icon` or `customicon` keys is present (`ndict.get("icon") or ndict.get("customicon")`) -- there is no field capturing `icon` distinctly from `customicon` today.
